reuse.why: Extracts the unlink field-clearing into clearAccountLink and uses it from both unlinkAccount and the new takeover path, and extends the existing assertNotLinkedElsewhere check rather than writing a new query.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the assert/assertNotClosed/releaseLinks sequence is repeated in the two link entry points, following the pre-existing pattern there.

placement.why: Everything stays in accounts/app.ts next to the existing link guards and unlink action, and all providers get the flag through the shared linkSyncServerAccount.

scope.why: Besides the feature it rewrites assertNotClosed (drops the tombstone filter and adds a new not-found error), an unrelated behaviour change.

maintainability.why: Clear and small, though assertNotLinkedElsewhere now both asserts and returns the ids to release under a flag, which makes its name misleading, and releaseLinks is a thin wrapper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing link guard and shares the unlink field reset with unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The unlink update is extracted and shared, not copied.
